# Memory, Arenas, `Addr` & FFI

Edva executes without a garbage collector or runtime type headers. Memory is managed deterministically through stack values, scoped bump arenas, explicit `Builder` buffers, and raw `Addr` pointers for low-level systems and C FFI interoperability.

## Runtime value and memory model

| Category | Types | Allocation & Passing Model |
|---|---|---|
| **Immediate register values** | `Int`, `i8`..`u64`, `Float`, `f32`, `Rune`, `<>`, `Addr`, `()` | Held directly in CPU/SIMD registers and stack slots; zero heap allocation |
| **Unboxed descriptors / pairs** | `String` (16B), `T[]` (16B), `A => B` (16B), `RamPP` `{ i1, i64 }` (16B), `Enum` `{ i64, ptr }` (16B) | Descriptors pass by value in registers; pointed-to payload bytes live in the active arena |
| **Growable arena containers** | `Builder` (24B), `T{}` (24B), `K ^ V` (`ptr`) | Backing buffers allocate and double in the active arena |
| **Deep copy (`++x`)** | `String`, `Builder`, `Record`, `T{}`, `T[]` | Allocates a fresh copy in the current arena (use before arena scope exit to promote values) |
| **State binding lens (`~~lvalue`)** | Mutable variable `x'`, field `r.f`, array slot `xs(i)`, map slot `m ^ k` | Constructs a two-way accessor record `(get: () => T, set: T => ())` |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

probe: () => Int
probe = !=>
   count' = 10
   lens = ~~count'
   lens.set(lens.get! + 5)
   count'

io::out $ probe!   // 15
```

## Raw pointers (`Addr`), `&`, and volatile memory (`@[...]`)

`Addr` (alias `ptr`) is an untyped raw memory address (8 bytes on 64-bit targets, 4 bytes on 32-bit targets, lowered to LLVM `ptr`).

| Operation | Syntax | Operand / Result Types | Rules & Diagnostics |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Null / integer cast** | `Addr(0)`, `Addr(0x1000)`, `Int(p)` | `Int` (`i8`..`u64`) $\leftrightarrow$ `Addr` | Bidirectional between integerish scalars and `Addr`. Casting records/arrays/functions via `Addr(rec)` emits `E3084` (use `&rec`) |
| **String / Builder data ptr** | `&s`, `&b` | `String` / `Builder` $\to$ `Addr` | No space after `&`. `&s` points to NUL-terminated UTF-8 bytes; `&b` points to writable buffer |
| **Composite address** | `&rec` | `Record` / tuple $\to$ `Addr` | Pointer to record storage |
| **Scalar out-parameter** | `libc::fn(fd, &len')` | Scalar variable $\to$ `Addr` | Permitted **strictly in downward call-argument position**; storing `p = &len'` emits `E3078` |
| **Pointer arithmetic** | `p + offset`, `p - offset` | `Addr`, `Int` $\to$ `Addr` | Byte-offset pointer arithmetic |
| **Pointer comparison** | `p1 == p2`, `p1 < p2`, `p1 !< p2` | `Addr`, `Addr` $\to$ `<>` | Unsigned address comparison |
| **Provenance bitmask** | `%ptrmask(p, mask)` | `Addr`, `Int` $\to$ `Addr` | Masks pointer bits (e.g. `0b1{48}`) while preserving LLVM pointer provenance |
| **Volatile typed load** | `@[addr T]` | `Addr`, `Type` $\to$ `T` | Reads value of type `T` from `addr` (or zero-copy record view when `T` is a `#packed` record) |
| **Volatile untyped store** | `@[addr] = val` | `Addr`, `val: T` $\to$ `()` | Stores `val` at `addr` using the width of `val`. Writing `@[addr T] = val` emits `E2093` |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

b = {16}
@[&b] = 69u8
@[&b + 1] = 100u8
@[&b + 2] = 118u8
@[&b + 3] = 97u8
?b = 4
io::out $ +b   // Edva
```

## C FFI (`#foreign`, `#export`) and ABI conventions

| FFI Feature | Syntax & Convention | Specification |
|---|---|---|
| **Import C symbol** | `#foreign "c" open: Addr, i32, i32 => i32`<br>`#foreign "m" hypot: Float, Float => Float` | Links against `libc`, `libm`, or native libraries declared in `edva.ccl` (`native.libs` / `native.pkg-config`); explicit type signature required (`E2060`) |
| **Export C symbol** | `#export compute: i32, i32 => i32` | Emits unmangled symbol with platform C calling convention |
| **C string passing** | `libc::puts(&s)` | Whole `String` values guarantee `data[len] == '\0'`; slices `s(a..b)` share interior bytes and must be copied (`++sub`) if a trailing `\0` is required by C |
| **C buffer reads** | `n = libc::read(fd, &b, 1024); ?b = n` | Pass `&b` for writable buffer pointer, then update `?b = n` (`0 <= n <= cap`, `E4008`) |
| **C struct layout** | `#type Stat (...)` / `#type Hdr #packed (...)` | Named records match platform C `struct` ABI layout; `#packed` and `#align N` match `__attribute__((packed, aligned(N)))` |

## Supported target triples and architecture rules

Pass `-t <triple>` (or `--target <triple>`) on the CLI or set `target = <triple>` under `targets =` in `edva.ccl`:

| Target Triple | Architecture | `Int` Width | `Addr` Width | Runtime Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` | x86-64 Linux (default host) | 64-bit (`i64`) | 64-bit (8B) | Full POSIX / `libc` / `io_uring` support |
| `aarch64-linux-gnu` | ARM64 Linux | 64-bit (`i64`) | 64-bit (8B) | Requires AArch64 sysroot/linker when cross-linking |
| `wasm32-unknown-unknown` | WebAssembly (freestanding) | 64-bit (`i64`) | 32-bit (4B) | Exports `#export` functions directly; `--cflag -msimd128` enables SIMD128 |
| `wasm32-wasi` | WebAssembly System Interface | 64-bit (`i64`) | 32-bit (4B) | Hosted WASI I/O and filesystem |
